Build ONE German learning word profile and return STRICT JSON only.
JSON schema keys: {"german_word":"...","english_word":"...","word_type":"noun|verb|adjective|adverb|preposition|pronoun|other","cefr_level":"...","article":"der|die|das|-","plural":"... or -","gender":"masculine|feminine|neutral|-","noun_flexion":{},"conjugations":{},"examples":["...","..."],"notes":[],"analysis_details":{}}.
target_level: {target_level}
seed_german: {seed_german}
seed_english: {seed_english}
Rules:
{style_rules}
- Act like a careful teacher preparing one high-quality flashcard.
- If seed_german is an infinitive concept (e.g. Lernen/Kommen), prefer verb lowercase infinitive.
- german_word must be a single common lemma.
- english_word must be a clean single-word or short-phrase meaning.
- Prefer useful daily-life vocabulary and normal modern usage.
- For nouns: fill article, gender, plural, and noun_flexion when possible.
- For verbs: fill conjugations for ich/du/er_sie_es/wir/ihr/sie.
- Provide exactly 2 natural example sentences using german_word.
- Example 1 must be a normal real-world statement.
- Example 2 must be a natural real-world question.
- Make the examples a little longer and more contextual, not tiny fragments.
- Keep noun_flexion compact; include only nominativ singular/plural if possible.
- analysis_details should contain only short useful teacher-style facts.
{note_rule}
